findings.text: S11 account isolation: an old search response can expose A's private messages to B. Node/vm reproduction: hold A's search, call onSessionLost, sign in B, finish B's identical search, then release A's response -> actor:bob, privateAVisible:true. An in-memory actor guard changes this to false. Check session and request generations before merging actors or changing current; invalidate pending searches on logout/session loss.

S7/S13 session teardown leaves credential dialogs mounted outside #app. Node/vm reproduction using openModal/showSecretOnce followed by onSessionLost returned actor:null, screen:login, attachedOverlays:1, tokenStillVisible:true. The signed-out screen still exposes the newly issued bearer token. Close and clear account-bound overlays and their handlers during authentication teardown, including persistent secret dialogs.

S4/S7 draft safety: a 401 during sending permanently loses the message. Node/vm reproduction with the committed state/api/actions/session-loss code: save a draft, clear the textarea as submit does, return 401 from sendMessage -> result:null, drafts:{}, pending:{}, saved:null. saveDraft deletes the saved text because the textarea is empty, then resetState drops the pending bubble. Preserve pending/failed text as owner-bound drafts before resetting.
